subject: RDMA: Use conn ref counter to prevent double close (#1250)
reason: The change is confined to src/rdma.c, the RDMA connection type's close/handler path. RDMA is not compiled into the runner's builds (BUILD_RDMA defaults to no and is module-only), loading it would need MODULE LOAD (refused) plus librdmacm, and exercising it needs RDMA hardware or a root-configured soft-RoCE device, which these runs lack. All fuzzer components connect over TCP, so no installed or writable experiment can reach connRdmaClose or rdmaProcessPendingData; the change is untestable in this environment and gets no scenario.
